summary: Iteration 3 — final production sanity check. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass covering the new admin credentials (admin@sdenterprises.in / admin123), rejection of the OLD admin creds (packnfly96@gmail.com returns 401), brute-force lockout via public URL (now correctly returns 429 on 6th attempt since keying is by email — the ingress-IP bug from iteration 2 is fixed), /auth/me + logout + change-password + forgot/reset flows (all restore back to admin123), empty-state (customers=[], partners=[], invoices=[], company defaults to SD ENTERPRISES with no assets, next-number SDE/2026-27/0001, uploads/company/ empty), company update + logo upload/get/delete, customer & partner CRUD, invoice create → duplicate → update → PDF (>3.5KB, %PDF magic) → delete cleanup, monthly-excel xlsx + 400 on invalid month, reports summary shape. Frontend Playwright: all 6 protected routes (/, /invoices, /invoices/new, /customers, /partners, /reports, /settings/company) redirect to /login when unauthed and render correctly when logged in; login with new admin lands on Dashboard; /login while authed redirects to /; token persisted in localStorage as sde_access_token (len 235); session survives reload; sidebar has all 6 nav items (Dashboard, Invoices, Customers, Courier Partners, Reports, Settings); Dashboard shows 0 invoices / ₹0 billed / ₹0 collected / ₹0 outstanding / 'No invoices yet — create your first one'; Invoices/Customers/Partners empty-states present; Settings > My Company pre-fills name 'SD ENTERPRISES' with no logo/signature/stamp; user menu opens with Change password + Sign out items; logout clears sde_access_token and returns to /login. No console warnings/errors (Login.jsx setState-during-render is gone). DB restored to fully clean state after tests: 0 customers, 0 partners, 0 invoices, empty company, counter=0001, uploads dir empty.

issues: Still using native <input type='date'> instead of shadcn Calendar (carried over from iteration 1/2; low priority — functional).

critical_code_review_comments: Brute-force lockout key is now `email:{email}` (routes_auth.py:76) — proxy-IP bug from iteration 2 is fixed; verified via public URL (429 on 6th attempt). Consider a small per-IP outer cap too, so a single attacker cannot burn one email at a time indefinitely, but not blocking for this MVP.

PUT /api/invoices/{id} requires the full InvoiceCreate payload (customer_id + items + gst_type + tax_rate). Partial PATCH semantics are not supported — fine for the current UI which always sends full payload, but documenting for future reference.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes ADMIN_PASSWORD on every startup; confirmed the old user was purged and only the new admin@sdenterprises.in exists (old creds return 401).
GET /api/company auto-creates the default doc on first read (get_or_create_company) — perfect for empty-DB bootstrap; confirmed after wipe.

PDF file size is 3.9KB for a bare-minimum invoice (no logo/signature/full customer address). Realistic invoices with brand assets sail past 4KB, so the >3.5KB threshold in tests is safe but you may want to bump default template padding for a more professional feel.
